tax.text: She supported tax cuts that reduce federal taxes on overtime pay.
tax.quote: Reducing taxes on overtime pay helps ensure that when workers step up to serve their communities, they are able to keep more of what they earn.

wages.text: She said wages offered by employers show the labor market is already responding above the minimum wage.
wages.quote: So I think you're already seeing the marketplace respond to that.

trade.text: She introduced legislation removing duties on imported phosphate fertilizer to improve global supply and lower costs.
trade.quote: This bill takes a commonsense approach to lowering fertilizer costs by improving access to a reliable global supply while maintaining a strong domestic industry.

debt.text: She said Social Security and Medicare should be protected while the government addresses waste and abuse.
debt.quote: That means protecting programs like Social Security and Medicare for those who rely on them, while rooting out abuse and restoring accountability across the board.

housing.text: She voted for housing legislation aimed at increasing supply and cutting regulatory red tape.
housing.quote: This legislation takes meaningful action to cut unnecessary red tape, increase housing supply, lowe rent, and make it easier for working families to achieve homeownership.

schools.text: She introduced the CHOICE Act to expand educational choice.
schools.quote: To expand opportunity through greater choice in education, and for other purposes.

safety.text: She supported appropriations funding police technology, facilities, and other enforcement-oriented public-safety equipment.
safety.quote: It includes license plate recognition systems, new body and in-car cameras, upgraded police facilities, school safety panic buttons, a real-time crime monitoring system, and a search-and-rescue drone.

guns.text: She supported legislation barring federally assisted housing landlords from restricting tenants' lawful firearm ownership.
guns.quote: This legislation evens the playing field for gun owners and prohibits landlords from discriminating against a tenant’s legal right to own a gun.

abortion.text: She described herself as pro-life, with exceptions for the life of the mother, rape and incest, and said she considered a 15-week limit reasonable.
abortion.quote: my position on abortion has always been that I am pro-life with exceptions for life of the mother, rape and incest, and that has not changed.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She voted for legislation basing participation in women’s sports on reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: ensure that athletic participation is based solely on a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth.

energy.text: She backed expanding domestic energy production and said fracking produces affordable energy.
energy.quote: American energy should remain in American hands, and fracking produces affordable energy and strengthens our national security.

voting.text: She voted for the SAVE Act requirement that applicants show proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections.
voting.quote: requiring proof of United States citizenship to register an individual to vote in elections for Federal office.

wages.text: She says she would invest in organized labor and union-protected work hours while seeking to increase jobs and wages.
wages.quote: Growing Iowa’s economy to increase jobs and wages while continuing to invest in organized labor and union protected man hours

trade.text: She says Congress should end tariffs, which she describes as raising costs for Iowans.
trade.quote: Exercising Congress’s power to end the disastrous tariffs that are one of the biggest tax increases in American history

housing.text: She proposes building and rehabilitating more housing to improve affordability.
housing.quote: Building and rehabilitating more housing to make it affordable for every Iowan to find a safe place to live

schools.text: She supports reinvesting in public schools and opposes diverting public funds to private school vouchers.
schools.quote: Reinvest in public education at every level: pre-K and K-12 schools, community colleges and universities, and skills training and apprenticeships

immigration.text: She supports additional border enforcement while also supporting a path to citizenship for certain law-abiding immigrants.
immigration.quote: I’ll work with anyone to put more Border Patrol agents on the ground, expand inspection equipment to stop fentanyl trafficking, and increase processing capacity.

guns.text: She supports the Second Amendment but says passing background checks is important to address gun violence.
guns.quote: one of the things that I think is so important is to pass background checks

health.text: She supports a Medicare buy-in and expanded public coverage while retaining private insurance as an option.
health.quote: I oppose forcing everyone onto Medicare, so I oppose a single-payer system. I want everyone to have health care coverage, and I want everyone to have choices.

voting.text: She supports the Let America Vote Act to let independent voters participate in primaries.
voting.quote: Expand Iowans' voice and fight extremism in both parties by passing the Let America Vote Act to allow the 33% of Iowans who are independents to participate in primaries

immigration.text: He criticized both insufficient attention to the border and the rounding up of long-time community members, saying the answer lies in the middle.
immigration.quote: Now we see the pendulum swing all the way to the other side, where we have the issues in Minneapolis, we have community members that have been here a long time, contributing, being rounded up. The answer is in the middle.
